description: Hand your step report over to the portal as the LAST action of a dispatched job, instead of posting the ticket comment yourself. The portal records the verdict on the step (the playbook gate reads it from there), writes the ticket comment from your report in the account's report shape — a readable comment, a short summary with the report attached as a numbered file, both, or nothing at all on the quiet shape — translates it when a report language is set, and edits the comment of an earlier call in the same step instead of posting again. Publish evidence with publish_artifact first and pass its links as evidence. Every failure is non-fatal: the result then tells you to post your ONE comment yourself. To ask a person, add up to 3 question parts in parts and declare the verdict your workflow has for it; then END YOUR SESSION after this call — the answers continue it (or start the workflow again with them in its hint). The result names the questions recorded; when it names none, nothing was asked.

body.description: The full report in Markdown — the sections your workflow asks for (what changed, how to verify, the handoff checklist, the findings). No closing verdict line: the portal adds it.

evidence.description: Links that evidence the report: the PR, the download links publish_artifact returned (at most 20).

filename.description: Optional name for the report file (Markdown); the portal numbers it on the ticket when it attaches it.

parts.description: Optional parts of the report (kadmo.report.parts.v1). The portal reads the question part: at most 3 a report. Another part type is dropped with a warning. A malformed question refuses the report: correct it and call again.

choices.description: Up to 3 answers to pick from.

label.description: What the person reads, at most 30 characters.

recommended.description: Your suggestion (at most one): shown marked, never preselected.

value.description: What you get back, at most 100 characters; the label when absent.

id.description: The question's id, unique in the report: 1 to 32 of A-Z a-z 0-9 _ . -

other.description: Whether an answer in the person's own words is welcome; true by default when there are no choices.

text.description: The question, at most 600 characters: what you need and why.

to.description: Whom it is for: "requester" (the default), or a person's name or address.

summary.description: One or two sentences: what the step did and where it stands (at most 2,000 characters).

verdict.description: The step verdict token, one of the workflow's verdicts (e.g. PR_OPEN, WORK_CONTINUE, BLOCKED, PASS, FAIL). Only the token — never a sentence.

name: publish_report
